summary: Route semantic LLM calls through SubLLM

delivery.outcome: Subactor-owned todo2code semantic calls use the centrally resolved SubLLM provider, model, credentials and application identity
nonGoals: No automatic replay after a paid provider request starts
No duplicated provider or model catalog in todo2code

architecture.decision: Resolve one todo2code/semantic route through the installed Python SubLLM CLI at the existing internal LLM boundary, cache only non-secret route metadata plus the in-memory selected credential, and adapt the provider wire request without changing callers
architecture.rollback: Disable the SubLLM integration flag or revert the ticket branch; deterministic extraction and the standalone OpenRouter path remain unchanged

validation.evidence: Public route reports provider zai and wire model glm-5.2 with priority 10
Secret-safe bridge and failure cases pass
Captured request contains Z.AI identity and excludes OpenRouter-only fields
Host, governance and Docker gates pass
HTTP 200 and response model glm-5.2 with secret-free audit
